title: Between vulnerability and resilience: A network analysis of fluctuations in cognitive risk and protective factors following remission from depression
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network
limitations: - ESM limited in number of variables that can be repeatedly assessed; - Subjective resilience ratings may overlap with positive affect and depressive symptoms; - Data limited to 7 days, not diagnostic for recurrence; - Sample limited to remitted depressed patients, not generalizable to other disorders.
notes: The study was part of a pre-registered project (osf.io/g2k4w). The code and data are likely available but not explicitly stated in the paper. The centrality test was based on visual inspection, not formal statistical tests.
